column1: # Real-rate tuning - the authored (judgement) input of gen_weapon_rof.py (user 2026-11-10: "set every gun's rate of fire to
# its real-world value, and do the same for enemy and friendly AI").
# The RATE itself is not typed here: it comes from recoil_research.tsv / recoil_measured.tsv (measured beats spec) through
# the stem -> physics map in recoil_shape.tsv. A row here only (a) overrides a rate where the sources disagree and the
# measured figure is not the defensible pick - with the reason, (b) sets the AI burst length, (c) forces a pellet count.
# stem      game tik stem (finish variants follow their base by suffix stripping, like the recoil patterns)
# rpm       override rate, rounds/min ('-' = take the sources)
# aiburst   rounds an AI fires per burst before it lets go of the trigger (period doctrine / manuals; '-' = class default)
# count     bullets per shot ('-' = the tik's); MG42 / M1919 tiks fire 2 bullets a shot - one real round is one bullet
# ttk       'free' = do not retune damage to hold today's TTK (the before value was an artifact - say why in note)

column6: sources 400-550: the 400 is a Soviet lend-lease impression, not a timed test; 500 is the common manual figure (Wikipedia 500-550)
